context: A teacher walks a uni student through an East-Europe history paper
purpose: Teach: 祖国/敵対/全日本/肖像/風水/ハンガリー/鳥取/徳島

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: レンくん、東欧史のレポート、テーマはハンガリーで決まり？
lines.en: Ren, for your East European history paper, are you going with Hungary?
lines.style: Warm teacher checking in with a familiar student

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、ハンガリー人にとっての祖国意識を、冷戦期の視点で書きたいんです。
lines.en: Yes, I want to write about the Hungarian sense of homeland from a Cold War perspective.
lines.style: Earnest university student presenting his angle clearly

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: いいね。ただ「西側と敵対するソ連の衛星国」という単純な図式に流れないように気をつけて。
lines.en: Good. Just be careful not to drift into the simple framing of a Soviet satellite hostile to the West.
lines.style: Gentle but firm academic guidance from teacher

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 確かに。一次資料として、当時の指導者の肖像写真とか演説記録を使うつもりです。
lines.en: Right. As primary sources, I plan to use portrait photos of leaders at the time and speech transcripts.
lines.style: Student responsively adjusting and showing research plan

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: あと、私の研究室にね、全日本東欧研究会が出してる紀要が揃ってるから、貸せるよ。
lines.en: Also, in my office I have the full set of bulletins from the All-Japan East Europe Study Society, so I can lend them.
lines.style: Helpful teacher offering concrete academic resources

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本当ですか、助かります！ちなみに先生、ご出身ってどちらでしたっけ、鳥取？
lines.en: Really? That's a huge help! By the way, where were you from again, sensei—Tottori?
lines.style: Grateful student making polite small talk shift

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: ううん、徳島だよ。鳥取はうちの夫の実家。風水的に良い土地だって義母がよく言ってる。
lines.en: No, I'm from Tokushima. Tottori is my husband's hometown. My mother-in-law always says it has good feng shui.
lines.style: Casual personal aside with light family humor

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: へえ、面白いですね。じゃあ来週、紀要お借りしに伺います。
lines.en: Oh, that's interesting. Then I'll come by next week to borrow those bulletins.
lines.style: Polite student wrapping up the meeting respectfully
